profile_text.body:
Amazon is a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States, with its website at amazon.com. The text drawn from the company's own site contained no descriptive content, so no self-description, product list, or stated AI position is available for this profile.

The record lists no products for Amazon. It does list four MCP servers tied to Amazon data: ai.sellermate/amazon-ads, described as a remote MCP for asking an Amazon Ads account questions and acting with guardrails, using OAuth and free to connect; ai.trendsapi/amazon, for Amazon product search volume and best-seller trends, with a free key at trendsapi.ai; ai.trendsmcp/amazon, for Amazon product search demand over time with growth for any keyword, with a free key at trendsmcp.ai; and app.apiguru/amazon-data, for live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer and stock and seller data across 20 marketplaces.

Two litigation facts are also held. One is a law exposure count of 114 in Washington. The other is a case, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware.
